sections.Profile:
The "King Kong" pinball machine by Data East, released in January 1990, is a rare game with only nine units produced. It features three flippers, two ramps, and no multiball mode, showcasing a classic gameplay style. Designed by Jerry Armstrong with artwork by Kevin O'Connor, this machine is noted for its unique theme and limited availability.
